753:t_157:1.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Are you saying you'll grant my wish or something?」

753:t_157:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Exactly. If you wish it, I shall arrange for you to reunite with your loved ones in the new world.」

753:t_157:3.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Sorry, you would-be god! I'm not that patient!」

753:t_157:4.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「So I'll protect the present with my own hands! I'll protect this world we're in now, which leads to the future!!」

753:t_157:5.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「I'm $$ロックオン・ストラトス$$! I'll snipe my target even if he's God!!」

753:t_158:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$アレルヤ$$... and $$ハレルヤ$$, $$ピーリス$$, $$マリー$$... I shall save your wounded souls.」

753:t_158:1.en:
$$ピーリス$$
「Is this man... trying to win us over!?」

753:t_158:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「No. With my great love, I shall end your fighting.」

753:t_158:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You will become new lives in a new world, and find new happiness.」

753:t_158:5.en:
$$ハレルヤ$$
(Don't let him sweet-talk you, $$アレルヤ$$! Basically, he's saying he'll kill us!)

753:t_158:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Death is merely a rite of passage. I shall carry your souls, freed of flesh, into the new world.」

753:t_158:7.en:
$$ハレルヤ$$
(So he is going to kill us after all! That's the kind of bastard he is!)

753:t_158:8.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「You're right, $$ハレルヤ$$! He's the kind of man who takes people's lives with a smile!」

753:t_158:9.en:
$$ピーリス$$
「We can't hand our lives or our future over to a man like that! Let's go, $$アレルヤ$$!」

753:t_158:10.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「I'm $$アレルヤ・ハプティズム$$! I'll end all this fighting here!!」

753:t_159:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ティエリア$$... Your mission as a born $$イノベイド$$ is over. Rest in peace.」

753:t_159:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「You don't get to decide that! My mission is to watch over humanity's course... in other words, $$刹那$$'s fight!」

753:t_159:2.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「And my mission is to fight anyone who stands in its way!」

753:t_159:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Rest assured. I shall determine humanity's future.」

753:t_159:4.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「I have no intention of listening to someone who approves of the universe's collapse!」

753:t_159:5.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「I'm $$ティエリア・アーデ$$! I'll strike down the one standing in the way of humanity's future here!!」

753:t_159:6.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「That is my mission as an $$イノベイド$$, and the reason $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ exists!!」

753:t_160:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$グラハム$$... Will you throw away the life that was saved?」

753:t_160:1.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I won't let anyone decide how I use my life!」

753:t_160:2.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I'll use my life for humanity's future...! In other words, I'll use it to defeat you!」

753:t_160:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Humanity in this world has no future. I have already explained that.」

753:t_160:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Your fight is futile, $$グラハム$$!」

753:t_160:5.en:
$$グラハム$$
「You evil god! Don't use my name so familiarly!」

753:t_160:6.en:
$$グラハム$$
「My comrades will follow the path I open! I'll teach you that even this small life isn't wasted!!」

753:t_161:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Do you reject me as well, $$パトリック$$?」

753:t_161:1.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Some god you are! Only the Colonel... I mean, the Brigadier General gets to call me that!」

753:t_161:2.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「You can call me the Immortal $$コーラサワー$$ or the Happy $$コーラサワー$$!」

753:t_161:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Then I shall do so.」

753:t_161:4.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「You fell for it, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

753:t_161:6.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「You admitted I'm immortal and lucky! That means you can't win!」

753:t_161:7.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「I'll do it, Colonel! I'll finish this guy off, go back to Earth and get you to praise me!!」

753:t_162:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Your sorrow-filled fighting ends today. $$シン$$... You are free now.」

753:t_162:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Rejoice. All fighting will soon end, and the universe will be reborn.」

753:t_162:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「No, I will not. Accept it, $$シン$$.」

753:t_162:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Your fight will soon end when everything returns to nothingness.」

753:t_162:7.en:
$$シン$$
「I'm the one who decides when my fight ends! And I can already see its goal!」

753:t_162:8.en:
$$シン$$
「That's defeating you, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, and saving the universe!」

753:t_162:10.en:
$$シン$$
「I won't listen to you! I'll overcome war... I'll overcome you!!」

753:t_163:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Your regret-filled days are over, $$キラ$$. Sorrow and suffering will vanish along with this world.」

753:t_163:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「That means the lives in this world will be lost...」

753:t_163:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Those lives will be reincarnated in the new world. There is nothing to fear.」

753:t_163:3.en:
$$キラ$$
「You can say that... because you had eternal life yourself...」

753:t_163:4.en:
$$キラ$$
「You don't understand what life means! That's why you can do something like that!」

753:t_163:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That is God: an absolute being you cannot surpass.」

753:t_163:6.en:
$$キラ$$
「I'll reject you by surpassing you!」

753:t_163:7.en:
$$キラ$$
「I have both conviction and strength...! They give me boundless power!!」

753:t_164:0.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「An ordinary soldier defeats God and saves the universe. That's not a bad ending.」

753:t_164:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You are quite a romantic for a soldier, $$ナイジェル$$.」

753:t_164:2.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Sorry. I consider myself a realist.」

753:t_164:3.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「I'll carry out what I said...! Brace yourself, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

753:t_165:0.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「I never thought I'd fight a self-proclaimed god to stop the universe's collapse.」

753:t_165:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I will become a true god, $$コンロイ$$.」

753:t_165:2.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「I don't trust people who get too familiar. And you stand out for how shady you are.」

753:t_165:3.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「$$エコーズ$$ fights anywhere, against anyone! When someone threatens civilians' peace and freedom, we fight to eliminate them!」

753:t_166:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$シャア$$... Beyond being a $$ニュータイプ$$, you were a man with the power to lead humanity into the future.」

753:t_166:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「Hearing that gives me all the more reason to refuse to let myself or the world end here...!」

753:t_166:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Do you intend to stop the universe's collapse and take on the role of guiding humanity?」

753:t_166:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「I don't know what lies ahead... But unless we stop you here, humanity has no future...!」

753:t_166:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「I swore to risk my life for that! I swore to $$ララァ$$... and $$フロンタル$$!」

753:t_166:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You are bound by the dead...! You cannot let go, $$赤い彗星$$!」

753:t_166:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「That's not it! I'm simply fighting for the future they wished for!」

753:t_166:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$, you stand in humanity's way! We will surpass you and move forward!!」

753:t_167:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Rest now, $$マリーダ$$. You no longer need to fight.」

753:t_167:1.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「That isn't convincing coming from you, my enemy...!」

753:t_167:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I am not your enemy. I am a being who saves everyone.」

753:t_167:3.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「How can a man who only stands by watching the universe collapse say that!?」

753:t_167:4.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「I won't accept a being like you! I'll fight anyone who steals the future... who steals the light!」

753:t_168:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$クェス$$... I shall fill your loneliness.」
